subprocesses.name: Invoicing
subprocesses.description: Registers the customer, drafts the invoice with its items and issues it.
subprocesses.trigger: An operator needs to bill a customer

steps.title: Register the customer
steps.description: Registers the customer that will receive the invoice.

steps.title: Create the invoice
steps.description: Creates the invoice in Draft with its billable items.

steps.title: Issue the invoice
steps.description: Validates the totals and moves the invoice to Issued.

subprocesses.name: Settlement
subprocesses.description: Records the customer's payment against the issued invoice.
subprocesses.trigger: The payment from the customer arrived

steps.title: Locate the invoice
steps.description: Finds the issued invoice the payment settles.

steps.title: Record the payment
steps.description: Records the payment and moves the invoice to Paid.
